items: Reply to every review, positive and negative, because an unanswered complaint lets the reviewer have the final say while a public reply shows other diners that you care.
Before answering a negative review, talk with the team involved to understand what happened, then own any mistake, apologize and invite the guest back.
Respond quickly, stay patient even when a review feels unfair, keep it impersonal to you, and proofread every reply before it goes out under your brand's name.
Prevent bad reviews by auditing the guest experience regularly, checking in with diners at the table, and asking happy guests to leave a review before they go.
